SD22-003.name: Claw Fox
SD22-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to any of your "Incarnate"/"Blade Insect" family Spirits/Ultimates.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

SD22-007.name: Gladitiger
SD22-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All Spirits/Ultimates with [High Speed] you control get +3000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void each to two Spirits/Ultimates with [High Speed] you control.

SD22-014.name: High Stampede
SD22-014.effect:
[Main]
During this turn, all your Spirits/Ultimates with [High Speed] get +5000 BP.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit/Ultimate +5000 BP.

SD22-002.name: Ladybird
SD22-002.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

SD22-006.name: Mugendragon
SD22-006.effect:
[LV1]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Purple.

[LV2]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Red.

[LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as White.

SD22-016.name: Neo-Binding Thorn
SD22-016.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.

SD22-015.name: Neo-Hand Reverse
SD22-015.effect:
[Main]
By discarding all cards from your Hand (at least one card), draw three cards.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit/Ultimate +5000 BP.

SD22-004.name: Nokogiru Kuwagata
SD22-004.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV2] (When Destroyed)
If you control any Ultimates, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

SD22-011.name: The Clouded Highlands
SD22-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your Spirit/Ultimate with [High Speed] is summoned, during this turn, give that Spirit/Ultimate +4000 BP.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your Spirit/Ultimate with [High Speed] is summoned, put a core from the Void to that Spirit/Ultimate. This effect can only be used once per turn.

SD22-012.name: The Great Tree of the Lush Grounds
SD22-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced by an opposing Spirit/Ultimate, draw a card.

[LV2]
When your Ultimate is summoned, exhaust an opposing Spirit.

SD22-013.name: Triangle Burst
SD22-013.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit attacks]
Summon a Cost 4 or less Spirit card/Ultimate card from your Hand. However, (When Summoned) effects can't activate. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. Or, exhaust three opposing Cost 4 or less Spirits.

SD22-X01.name: Ultimate-Kingtaurus
SD22-X01.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Green Spirits]

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, the opponent exhausts two Spirits they control. [Critical Hit] If the hit card is Cost 3 or less, also, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
[utb]

[LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)
For each core on this Ultimate, this Ultimate gets +1000 BP.

SD22-009.name: Ultimate-Monoqueiroz
SD22-009.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Green Spirits]

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate-Trigger hits, you can summon a Spirit card/Ultimate card with [High Speed] from your Hand without paying the cost.
[utb]

SD22-008.name: Ultimate-Tigald
SD22-008.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Green Spirits]

Flash - [High Speed]
This Ultimate card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Ultimate must also be from the Reserve.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4] (When Battles)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, if only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via comparing BP, refresh this Ultimate.
[utb]

SD22-010.name: Ultimate-Xen-Fu
SD22-010.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Green Spirits]

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, the opponent exhausts two Spirits they control.
[utb]

[LV4][LV5] (When Battles)
The opponent can't activate their Burst.

SD22-005.name: Wald-Jaeger
SD22-005.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
When summoned during (Either Attack Step), put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
